---
name: driftwood-project-management
description: Issue and artifact linking rules for driftwood work
applyTo: "**/*"
---

Treat GitHub Issues and pull requests as the default project tracker for this public repository. Link related issue, branch, commit, PR, test, model, and generated documentation artifacts when they exist.

Read operations are the default. Any infrastructure mutation, release, publication, or remote Git operation requires an explicit user request.
